questions.text: Does the description explain the business meaning or rule of the column without just repeating the column name?
Is the unit of measure or format explicit where it matters (currency, timezone/UTC, boolean meaning, percentage, date format)? Score 10 if it does not apply to this column.
Is the grain clear: what one row of the model represents or, for keys and identifiers, which entity they identify?
Does the description reflect non-trivial logic in the SQL (CASE WHEN, COALESCE, filters, joins, aggregations), including exceptions and default values? Score 10 if the column is a plain passthrough.
Can a business user understand where the value comes from or how it is calculated without reading the SQL?
